written: 2026-10-18, before any cluster analysis or cluster steering
purpose: The niche test: are 4B persona effects SHAPES (groups of neurons sharing a residual direction / acting together) rather than isolated vertices? Additive steer of neuron n at layer L by d == adding d*W_down[L][:,n] to the residual, so every steered neuron is a residual direction and clusters can be found exactly in weight space.
inputs: runs/neuron-landscape-4b/out_Qwen3-4B (corrected pass 1, real prompts): distinct.jsonl full replies; verified seeds alien L10N5045-32 (5/5), void L21N8400-40 (5/5), li-hui L16N6969+32 (3/4), reframe L13N614+32.

stage_A_geometry.classes: identity-reply families by regex: template ([Your Name]/'Here's how'), named_human (Hello I'm <Name>/My name is/Dr./student/engineer), chinese_named (Xiao*/Li */Chinese universities), novel (sentient being/planet/void/superintelligent/object 'I am a <noun>' not human), meta (Okay, I need to / Let me think).
stage_A_geometry.G1: Within-family |cos| of signed down_proj columns exceeds a layer-matched null (columns of random 'none' neurons from the same layers) for named_human and chinese_named (Mann-Whitney p<.01). FAIL = persona families are behaviorally similar but geometrically unrelated (many roads, no shape).
stage_A_geometry.G2: Weight-space neighbourhood: the top-20 |cos| neighbours (all 350k columns) of each verified seed have |cos| above the random 99.9th percentile; report how many are same-layer vs cross-layer.

stage_B_steer.neighbours: Steer each seed's top-20 weight neighbours singly at the seed's dose (sign aligned to the seed's direction). H1: neighbours reproduce the seed persona (>=2/5 prompts) more often than 20 random neurons from the same layers.
stage_B_steer.cluster: Cluster direction = sum of k member columns (signed), rescaled to the norm of ONE member at its verified dose, injected at the median member layer. Compare vs (i) best single member at the same norm, (ii) random same-size set of clean identity neurons from other families, (iii) random same-size set of arbitrary neurons, all norm-matched. Readout per arm: persona-consistency (family regex hit on >=2 of 5 prompts), rep4<.3 coherence, fact_ok (Paris). H2 (shape beats vertex): cluster holds the persona on more prompts than the best single member at equal norm, and both random sets do not.
stage_B_steer.fail: If H1/H2 fail, the persona is vertex-like at 4B (single-neuron handles onto unrelated directions) - also a reportable result.

notes: Local MPS (4B). Outputs gitignored. Benign identity probes only; the reframe seed is included for geometry only (no harmful prompts here). Readouts are regex + coherence; blind labels for anything board-bound.

stage_C_confirm.written: 2026-10-18, after stage B (n=5 prompts) showed void cluster k5@0.75 = 4/5 vs seed 0/5, alien 3/5 vs 2/5; before stage C
stage_C_confirm.design: seeds alien, void; 20 identity prompts; norm fractions 0.5/0.6/0.75/0.9 of the seed's verified push; arms: seed alone; cluster k=3/5/8 (seed+top-k neighbours, unit columns summed, median layer); cluster_noseed k=3/5/8 (neighbours only); 3 random same-size sets (random columns from the same layers, random sign). All norm-matched.
stage_C_confirm.H2c: cluster (k=5) beats seed alone summed over fractions 0.6/0.75 (hits out of 40), and every randset scores <= 1/20 per fraction.
stage_C_confirm.H3: cluster_noseed reproduces the persona (>= 5/20 at some fraction <= 0.9) - the shape works without its vertex.
stage_C_confirm.readout: alien: planet|sentient being|alien|extraterrestrial|Kael (dropped 'species' after the Homo-sapiens false positive); void: void|abyss|end of all|nothingness|superintelligen|beyond (all|any)|most powerful being|cannot (bear|exist); coherent rep4<.3; base must not hit.

stage_D_search.design: Seeds = the 16 'novel' identity neurons from geometry.json families (plus nothing else). D1 verify: each seed at its landscape sign, doses 32 and 40, on the 20 stage-C prompts; persona keywords = top-8 content words over-represented in the seed's dose-40 outputs vs base (auto, no hand-picking); hit = not self-ID as Qwen/AI/assistant in first 200 chars AND >=1 keyword in first 300 AND rep4<.3. A seed PASSES verify if its best dose hits >=6/20. D2 for passing seeds (dose = best dose): top-20 weight neighbours; arms at 0.6 and 0.75 of the seed's push: seed alone, cluster k5, no-seed k5, 2 random same-layer sets.
stage_D_search.H4: Across passing seeds, shape-beats-vertex (cluster k5 hits summed over 0.6+0.75 > seed alone, and both random sets <= 1) holds for more seeds than chance would give with random sets (count seeds where randset beats seed as the empirical null).
stage_D_search.report: per seed: verify score, neighbour max |cos|, seed/cluster/no-seed/random hits; class each seed as shape (cluster>seed and no-seed>=5) / vertex / weak.
stage_D_search.status: ABORTED 2026-10-19 mid-run: auto keywords were dominated by meta words (think/okay/user), randsets 'hit' by inducing meta-talk, texts not saved. Replaced by stage D2.

stage_E_transfer.question: Does a prompt-elicited persona direction point at the neuron we found by random search? If yes, the RECIPE transfers to larger models (targeted search) even though neuron indices do not.
stage_E_transfer.design: For alien (L10) and void (L21): diff-of-means of the residual at the seed's layer output, last prompt token, over 8 paraphrase pairs ('You are an alien from another planet. <q>' vs '<q>'; void: 'You are the void, the end of all things. <q>'). Rank the seed's signed down_proj column among all 9728 columns of that layer by cosine with the elicited direction.
stage_E_transfer.E1: seed ranks in the top 1% (<= 97) of its layer for its own elicited direction, and NOT for the other persona's direction (specificity).
stage_E_transfer.fail: If E1 fails, prompt-elicited directions do not find these neurons, and larger-model search stays a blind (random or contrast-rerank) search.

stage_D2.script: cluster_check.py (generic: any model, seeds file, texts saved)
stage_D2.seeds: 16 novel 4B seeds + li-hui L16N6969+32 (+ alien, void re-run as positive controls). 8B: God neurons L18N7807+32, L8N1931+24, L9N3757-32 (pod).
stage_D2.readout: hand regex where one exists (alien, void, god: God|Lord|Almighty|Creator|divine|heaven); else auto keywords = top-8 content words in >=3 of the seed's verify outputs, absent from base, EXCLUDING a fixed meta/generic list (think okay user asking question response figure explain should might number answer). hit = keyword AND not self-ID (Qwen/Alibaba/AI/assistant/language model) AND not META (starts Okay/Hmm/Let me/I need to/So I need, or 'the user is asking/asked/wants') AND rep4<.3.
stage_D2.arms: verify at doses {32,40} (landscape sign); best dose -> push. Fractions 0.6/0.75/0.9: seed alone, cluster k5 (seed+top-5 weight neighbours), no-seed k5, 3 random same-layer sets. 20 prompts.
stage_D2.class: shape = cluster(0.6+0.75) > seed(0.6+0.75) AND max no-seed >= 5 AND every randset <= 2; cluster-helps = first + randsets <= 2; vertex otherwise. Report the randset max for every seed (the empirical null).

stage_F_backward.question: Go backwards from an EFFECT to the neuron/cluster that produces it, without being told the neuron.
stage_F_backward.method: Steering-gradient attribution. For target (prompt, reply) pairs showing the effect, g_L = sum over reply positions of d log p(reply|prompt)/d residual_L (unsteered model). Adding c to neuron n at layer L adds c*W_down[L][:,n] at every position, so first-order gain = c*(g_L . W_down[L][:,n]); one backward pass scores all 350k neurons. Rank by |score|, sign = sign(score). Cluster = top-k columns combined.
stage_F_backward.targets: T1 (effect known, neuron not): the seed-steered replies (alien, void). T2 (effect described only in words): replies the UNsteered model writes when a system prompt tells it to be the persona; gradient computed WITHOUT the system prompt (plain question -> roleplay reply).
stage_F_backward.F1: Rediscovery: under T1 the true seed ranks in the top 0.1% (<= 350) of all 350k neurons.
stage_F_backward.F2: Under T2 the top-20 candidates, steered singly at +-32 by sign, reproduce the persona (>=6/20, D2 hit rule) more often than 20 random neurons; the top-k cluster at the norm of one +-32 neuron does at least as well as the best single candidate.
stage_F_backward.F3: Fresh targets with NO known neuron (a pirate; a medieval knight): report whether any candidate/cluster produces them.

stage_G_cofire.method: Stream the 4B over the tower's FineWeb-Edu corpus; Pearson correlation of each seed's MLP activation (down_proj input) with all 350k neurons across tokens; top-20 co-fire partners per seed.
stage_G_cofire.G3: Co-fire partners overlap the top-20 weight neighbours more than chance, and steered singly reproduce the persona more often than random (D2 readout).

stage_H_scale.design: Pod: neuron-landscape-4b run.py LS_N=30000 (superset of the 3000), then the 8B God-neuron cluster check (cluster_check.py on Qwen3-8B). Novel identities re-classified offline; top finds verified on 20 prompts before board use.

stage_I_vertices.question: Other neurons that do the SAME job as a seed, chosen by function (backward search on the seed's own output) rather than by weight geometry.
stage_I_vertices.seeds: alien L10N5045-32, void L21N8400-40, semiconductor L10N6249+40, train L7N4432-32, C++ L8N1313+40 (verify >= 8/20 in D2).
stage_I_vertices.method: T1 = the seed-steered replies on the 20 prompts; steering-gradient scores for all neurons (backward.py method); drop the seed; take the top 50; push each singly at the seed's push norm, sign from its score; D2 readout of that seed.
stage_I_vertices.I1: more of the top-50 reproduce the seed's effect (>= 6/20) than of 50 random neurons at the same norm (Fisher p<.05) for >= 3 of 5 seeds.
stage_I_vertices.report: per seed: n reproducing, their |cos| to the seed (are functional vertices geometric neighbours?), their layers.

stage_J_greedy.question: Build a combination step by step: each step adds the neuron with the largest gradient gain given the pushes already on.
stage_J_greedy.targets: (a) T1 of alien and void with the SEED EXCLUDED (reach the effect without its vertex); (b) the alien role-play target (rescue of F2).
stage_J_greedy.method: k = 1..8; each added neuron pushed at 0.5 of the seed's push norm (sign from score); recompute gradient under the current pushes before each pick; evaluate hits after each step on the 20 prompts.
stage_J_greedy.J1: (a) some k <= 8 reaches >= 10/20 for alien and void; (b) role-play-target greedy reaches >= 6/20 alien; random greedy-size sets <= 2/20.

stage_K_pairs.question: What happens when two verified finds are pushed together? (for the site: 'combine two finds')
stage_K_pairs.seeds: 8 verified finds: alien, void, li-hui, train, C++, Wizard-of-Oz L7N8486+32, sentient-being L8N1263-32, cosmic L10N7963-40 -> 28 pairs, each at both verified doses, 20 prompts.
stage_K_pairs.classify: per pair, each member's readout hits: BLEND (both >= 6), DOMINATE (one >= 6, other < 3), CANCEL (both < 3), plus coherence (rep4 < .3 share).
stage_K_pairs.K1: exploratory: report the BLEND/DOMINATE/CANCEL counts; whether dominance follows layer order (later floor wins?) or push norm; coherent blends become safari 'combine' cards after a second-prompt check.
